why: The backfill arm of 018. One entry per (target, entity), which the existing shape already fits because an entry names its `engine` and its `table` - both properties of the target rather than of the entity. The loop is **target outer, in `also_write` document order, and entity inner**, and the reason is what an operator can do after a crash: a target carried to the end is one `verify` can be run against, while advancing every copy an entity at a time leaves two half copies and nothing to check. A third implementation guessed the other order, which is how this sentence came to be written down. `rows_this_run` is 22 for 11 source rows because there are two copies.
